LESSON: RELATIONSHIP

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Relationship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Relationship. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: which obligations towards their neighbour?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify ways through which love and care can be extended to neighbours.
2. Demonstrate love and care for the neighbours for harmonious co-existence.
3. Appreciate the love and care for neighbours as an act of ibadah. neighbours. how to love and care for their neighbours.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify ways through which love and care can be extended to neighbours.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify ways through which love and care can be extended to neighbours. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Demonstrate love and care for the neighbours for harmonious co-existence.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate love and care for the neighbours for harmonious co-existence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate the love and care for neighbours as an act of ibadah. neighbours. how to love and care for their neighbours.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the love and care for neighbours as an act of ibadah. neighbours. how to love and care for their neighbours. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Relationship.
2. Explain Relationship to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners are guided on
4. Show that you can: Identify ways through which love and care can be extended to neighbours.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Relationship. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: which obligations towards their neighbour?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
